# Kapwing

> > Kapwing is an online video and image editing platform featuring AI-powered tools for content creation, meme generation, and social media optimization for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook.

Kapwing provides browser-based creative tools including green screen removal, background replacement, meme templates, and customizable fonts. The platform is designed for creators making content for social media platforms with no software installation required.

## Key Topics

- Online video editor
- AI video tools
- Green screen and chroma key
- Background removal and replacement
- Meme generator and templates
- TikTok content creation
- Instagram content creation
- YouTube video editing
- Customizable templates
- Social media content
- Font customization (Comic Sans, Impact, Montserrat, Arial)
- Video editing tools
- Image editing
- Content creation platform

## Video Editing Tools

- [Green Screen Remover + Background Replacer](https://www.kapwing.com/tools/green-screen?refresh=true): Chroma key tool to remove & replace video backgrounds for social media

## Meme Creation and Templates

- [Meme Templates — Free and Customizable — Kapwing](https://www.kapwing.com/meme-templates#!&refresh=true): Browse & customize trending meme templates with Kapwing's editor
- [Free Templates — Customizable and Online — Kapwing](https://www.kapwing.com/explore/trollface-meme-maker#!&refresh=true): Library of customizable video & image templates for TikTok and more

## Social Media Templates

- [Fancy font on an Instagram Post — Kapwing](https://www.kapwing.com/explore/fancy-font-on-an-instagram-post?refresh=true): Instagram template with cursive Great Vibes font for stylish captions
